Headline: Plan it right. Build it to last.
Subheadline: Kitchens, baths, basements and decks. David P Davis Construction plans the job with you and keeps the work organized from the first measurement to the final walkthrough.
About: We are a local contracting company in Catonsville taking on remodeling and home improvement projects across Baltimore County. One team, a clear plan and a tidy job site.
Services:
Kitchen remodeling | New layouts, cabinets, counters and finishes for the heart of your home.
Bathroom remodeling | Updated tubs, showers, tile and vanities.
Basement finishing | Turning unfinished space into rooms you will use.
Decks & outdoor living | Decks and porches built for Maryland seasons.
Additions | More room for your family without moving.
Repairs & carpentry | Trim, doors, drywall and the jobs in between.
Highlights:
One point of contact | You always know who to call about your project.
Clear scope and schedule | We agree what is included and when, before work begins.
Clean job site | Work areas kept safe and tidy every day.
Steps:
Talk it through | Tell us about the project and your goals.
Plan and quote | We measure, plan and give you a written quote.
Build | Work proceeds on the agreed schedule.
Walkthrough | We finish the details and walk the job with you.
